title: Universal operadic algebra fibration and fixed-operad limits
statement: Use the infinity-category, universe, and presentably monoidal conventions of [def-coef-complete-algebroid]. Use [lem-coef-infinity-grothendieck-limits-colimits] for Cartesian fibrations and [lem-coef-accessible-infinity-pullback] for accessible functors. A nonsymmetric infinity operad is an inner fibration $\mathcal O^\otimes\to\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$ with cocartesian lifts of inert arrows, Segal equivalences $\mathcal O_{[n]}\simeq\mathcal O_{[1]}^n$, and the corresponding product decomposition of mapping spaces over arrows of $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$. Write $\operatorname{Opd}^{\mathrm{ns}}_\infty$ for the infinity category of small such operads and inert-preserving functors. For a presentably monoidal $\mathcal V$, let $\operatorname{Alg}(\mathcal V)\to\operatorname{Opd}^{\mathrm{ns}}_\infty$ be the Cartesian fibration classified by $\mathcal O\mapsto\operatorname{Alg}_{\mathcal O}(\mathcal V)$, where an algebra is an inert-preserving functor over $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$. The base and total infinity categories are presentable and the projection is accessible. For every small generalized nonsymmetric infinity operad $\mathcal M$ with space $\mathcal M_{[0]}$, the category $\operatorname{Alg}_{\mathcal M}(\mathcal V)$ is presentable. Here generalized means the Segal decomposition is the iterated fiber product over $\mathcal M_{[0]}$, rather than a product over a point. Its small limits are created by restriction to the inert part and are computed pointwise on the colors: $\operatorname{ev}_c(\lim_j B_j)\simeq\lim_j\operatorname{ev}_c(B_j)$ for $c\in\mathcal M_{[1]}$. In particular, restriction along a map of these operads preserves small limits.
